description: Recons judged on their own clock. A Reconeyez detector's Online report counts for six hours (was 45 minutes; Recons report about hourly and the board already allows six hours). A detector whose last report was Offline and has been quiet since reads Down with when it was last heard, while the Reconeyez feed itself is current (was Not verified). The unit's time is its oldest Online report. One exact edit to live v27: projectReconUnits. Source: tech-checks/operations/shared/otherUnitStatus.ts.
